title: The Reserve Before the Risk
short_teaser: Some strategies create a buffer of time, money, energy, or inventory before taking a larger risk.
story: Some strategies create a buffer of time, money, energy, or inventory before taking a larger risk. The reserve does not eliminate uncertainty, but it changes the consequences. Resilience can be designed before pressure arrives. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Resilience can be designed before pressure arrives. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
